Alicia — appreciate the clear ask. Quick answers up front, then attachments below.

1) Term options: we will provide two routable private-offer templates in the same DocuSign package:
   - Option A: 12-month usage commitment (pay-as-you-go with a blended discount on per-token rates)
   - Option B: 12-month annualized prepay (single invoice, 10% additional discount, auto-renew opt-out)

   The one-pager will show activation triggers, term start (acceptance vs first invoice), and add-on cadence.

2) Evidence & activation flow: attaching SOC2 Type II, the standard DPA (Redwood_v1.2), and a 1-page ActivationChecklist that maps private-offer acceptance -> AWS activation -> Redwood provisioning -> invoice generation (payment terms NET30 by default; we can support NET45 with finance sign-off).

Who signs what internally: Redwood's Sales Director (Neha) signs the commercial private-offer document; Finance (Kimberly) signs off on invoicing terms if nonstandard. Legal only does DPA redlines for enterprise changes > standard scope.

Next steps I propose: I will upload the private-offer to AWS Marketplace once we get verbal approval from your committee; Tara from the AWS partner team is cc'd to help accelerate listing activation. If committee wants a 48-hour turn on the DocuSign, we can do it — otherwise standard 5 business days for processing.

I'm attaching: PrivateOffer_TermSheet.pdf, SOC2_TypeII.pdf, DPA_Redwood_v1.2.pdf, ActivationChecklist.xlsx

Best,
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Tom — thanks, noted. Adding a short finance paragraph here (we'll also update the PDF term sheet and resend):

   - Invoice timing: For Option B we will issue a single invoice at the time of private-offer activation (invoice date = activation date). Redwood Finance will mark the invoice as prepaid for the 12-month period.
   - Refund/adjustment: Redwood offers a pro-rata credit model for demonstrable underusage for the first 90 days only, subject to review. Annual prepay is not refundable after 30 days post-activation except for contractually defined exceptions (force majeure or egress errors). We'll put a one-sentence summary and reference the finance exception section in the term sheet.
   - Data separation: Brief statement: "Redwood provisions private deployments with dedicated tenant separation and customer-specific KMS keys; audit logs and access are restricted per the attached DPA and can be attested during SOC audits." We'll add this to the term sheet header.

We recommend moving forward with Option B and we can set the DocuSign envelope for signature once you confirm. Jordan — can you coordinate with Tara to confirm AWS activation SLAs (48-hour expedited vs 3–5 business days)?

Thanks,
